display_name: Manulife Việt Nam endowment with a three-stage critical illness benefit (CSTD; MoF letter 1997/BTC-QLBH, 20 February 2019): the whole document, Articles 1 to 32 and Annexes 1 to 3

run.method: one agent, one session, no sub-agents, from BRIEF.md (begun 2026-10-06, resumed 2026-10-07 after a usage-limit pause)

language.note: Identifiers and comments are English (@lang en). Vietnamese appears in `-- src:N |` comments generated by tools/vnsrc.py quote from line N of the raw text, and in short runs that tools/vnsrc.py check verifies occur verbatim in it. No line carries an encoder's own Vietnamese.

documents.authority: private standard-form contract terms published by the insurer; not law

aids_read: ../../../../../../.aids/law-08-2022-qh15.txt (Law on Insurance Business 08/2022/QH15, read only for LAW: forks; not encoded)

files: cstd-nouns.l4 (the three enumerations between the GENERATED markers)
generated.from: tools/conditions.py (hand-written reading of Annexes 1-3) and the raw text

scope: The whole document. Encoded: Articles 1 to 32 (104 coverage rows: 84 encoded, 20 inert with reasons, none out of scope or deferred; NOTES.md §2.1) and Annexes 1 to 3: all 147 separately headed conditions with list and item, the 118 thresholds their definitions state, the causes 42 of them exclude, and three bars between conditions (NOTES.md §2.2-2.3). The qualitative part of each annex definition is one certified fact. Amounts the Company sets (dividends, cash values, interest rates, the reduced paid-up sum insured) are inputs or named refusals. Gaps answer with nine named REFUSEs (NOTES.md §1).

forks.F-T1: Days, months and years are calendar ones.
forks.F-1.6a: Tuổi counts birthdays strictly before the effective date or anniversary.
forks.F-1.3: The 1 month to 65 Tuổi range is tested on the application day.
forks.F-1.2: The policyholder's 18 Tuổi is the policyholder's own completed years.
forks.F-3a: A death on the day temporary cover ends is outside it.
forks.F-4: The free-look runs to the 21st day after receipt.
forks.F-7a: An underpaid premium reduces the sum insured in proportion.
forks.F-12a: The funeral benefit needs death strictly after the first anniversary of the later of the effective and reinstatement dates.
forks.F-12b: A late-stage decision on or before the death switches 12.2 to 100%.
forks.F-13a: 13.3's last paragraph ends 13.1-13.3 on approval of the late-stage benefit.
forks.F-13.4a: Tuổi on a day is the defined Tuổi fixed for that policy year (13.4 and 14).
forks.F-13.4b: No age is required of the mother for 13.4(b)(ii).
forks.F-13.4c: The Annex 2 list for men covers only a male insured.
forks.F-13.5a: 13.5's Tuổi at the issue date is anchored on the issue date.
forks.F-13.5b: The coupon for issue Tuổi over 55 falls on the 20th anniversary.
forks.F-15a: The loyalty dividend falls at the anniversary ending the premium term.
forks.F-15b: 'less than 65 minus the premium term'; the other reading gives the same anniversaries.
forks.F-16.4: Accumulated dividends are not paid twice on death; coupons held are paid in addition.
forks.F-18a: After 90 days = from the 91st day after the issue or reinstatement date.
forks.F-18b: A death on the 30th day after diagnosis satisfies the survival period.
forks.F-18c: The Accident exception excuses both the waiting and the survival periods.
forks.F-19a: The second anniversary is outside the two-year suicide period.
forks.F-20: The grace period ends on the 60th day after the due date.
forks.F-21: Article 21's tests are applied as written; the uncovered case is a named refusal.
forks.F-28: Riders may be added only before the 6-month anniversary.
forks.F-29a: The last day to claim is one year after the insured event.
forks.F-29b: The insured event of a critical illness is its diagnosis.
forks.F-29c: Article 29 governs every claim, not only death claims.
forks.F-29d: A refusal is due in writing within the same 30 days.
forks.F-31a: Approval of the late-stage benefit ends the additional benefit too.
forks.F-32.4: 32.4 tests 1.3's conditions as at application; the literal reading is encoded separately.
forks.F-C2: Chapter 2's floor applies to the 12.2 and 17 benefit before settlement and Debt.
forks.F-CI-1: Each separately headed annex condition is one critical illness.
forks.F-CI-2: A dot or comma before one or two digits is a decimal point (1.5 mm, 3.5 g, -2.5).
forks.F-CI-3: Early pulmonary hypertension is NYHA class 3 exactly.
forks.F-CI-4: Late 'other serious coronary artery disease' is three arteries at 60% or more, one at 75%.
forks.F-CI-5: 'thuốc' in an exclusion is medicines or drugs.
forks.F-CI-6: Early CLL is RAI stage 1 to 2 inclusive.
forks.LAW-1: 19.1(a)'s anchor differs from Law Art 40(1)(a) (line 818-820); the document's is encoded.
forks.LAW-2: Law Art 30(2)'s knowledge rule (line 711-714) is not in the document; not encoded.
forks.LAW-3: 6.2 returns the surrender value; Law Art 22(2) (line 543-553) the premiums less costs; the document's is encoded.
forks.LAW-4: 5.1 deducts Debt; Law Art 22(3) (line 554-559) does not; the document's is encoded.
forks.LAW-5: Article 21's automatic loan against Law Art 37(4) (line 787-791); the document's is encoded.
forks.LAW-6: Articles 4, 20.2, 23 and 29.4 agree with Law Arts 35, 37(2)-(3), 31(1).
